The '''Polis Massa Base''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base located in the [[Polis Massa Asteroid Field]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The Polis Massa Base was located in the [[Polis Massa system/Legends|Polis Massa system]] of the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The base encompassed a series of outposts, facilities, tunnels and operational areas spread throughout the [[Polis Massa Asteroid Field]]. All the areas of the base were in fact abandoned [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massan]] facilities, mostly ancient research sites, converted by the Rebels with the supports of the Polis Massans. The Polis Massa Rebel base was divided in three parts: the primary base located on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] itself (the largest [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] of the Polis Massa Asteroid Field), the [[Polis Massa Research Base|Polis Massan Research Base]] also located on the largest asteroid, and isolated outposts scattered on the main asteroid and throughout the asteroid field. All the Rebel facilities on the main asteroid, including the primary base, the Polis Massa Research Base and the scattered outposts were connected by hidden underground tunnels.<ref name="Strongholds" />

[[File:PolisMassa.png|thumb|left|300px|The [[Polis Massa Research Base]].]]
The primary base was located in an area of abandoned archaeological digs, several miles away from the [[Wiyentaah crater]]. Converted and expanded by the Rebels, it was made of multiple buildings clustered together in three or four groups connected by tunnels. The second most important component of the Polis Massa Rebel base was the Polis Massan Research Base, in the Wiyentaah crater. This base was a civilian archeological research station inhabited by the Polis Massans who opened their facility to the Rebellion. The Rebellion had established their primary base several miles away from the research base to avoid to expose the Polis Massans unnecessarily at risk. The Rebels also limited their presence in the Polis Massan research base, although they made extensive use of its advanced [[Medical Treatment and Surgical Suites|medical center]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

Overall, the Polis Massa Base included [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], command centers, [[Communications array/Legends|communications arrays]], landing moorings, medical facilities, [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield]] and [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]], training areas, vehicle maintenance garages and two [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. It was defended by [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. The base was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elora Silssusio]] and housed 375 personnel: 25 [[Officer/Legends|officers]], 150 staff and 200 combat personnel, including [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="Strongholds" /> It was crewed by beings of different species, including Human troopers, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] archers, and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spies. They were also equipped with [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant droids]].<ref name="BF2" /> The base also included six [[Polis Massa flitter shuttle]]s, eight [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertanks]]<ref name="Strongholds" /> (such as [[AAC-1 speeder tank]]s),<ref name="BF2" /> 12 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] ([[Kip Famas]]'s [[94th Fighter/Attack Squadron]]), 12 [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing fighters]] ([[Pashna Genko]]'s [[88th Attack Squadron]]), two [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and some [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] supply ships.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==History==
{{Quote|We were supposed to go in, wipe out a small band of Rebels and recover some stolen Imperial plans on an encrypted holodisk. Before we knew it, we were nearly overrun by Rebel forces, with the holodisk nowhere to be found...|[[Retired clone trooper|Unnamed 501st stormtrooper]]|<ref name="BF2" />}}
[[File:BF_Polis_Massa_6.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] attacks Rebel forces during the [[raid on Polis Massa]].]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered a small [[Polis Massa decoy outpost|Rebel outpost]] on Polis Massa.<ref name="Strongholds" /> The facility was home to a Rebel cell which [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] believed the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] were transmitted to. These plans had been beamed from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] by the Alliance during a [[Death Star Uprising|prison break]]. Acting on this information, the Imperial [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Stormtrooper Legion]] [[Raid on Polis Massa|raided]] the facility and terminated all Rebel activity in the area. However, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were not able to secure the plans and were soon dispatched to the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in order to [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] that was suspected to carry the plans.<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> As Imperial forces hastily departed, they destroyed most of the Rebel outpost. The Empire did not realize that this base was just a minor outpost and never discovered the main Rebel facilities on the asteroid. The destroyed outpost became a decoy intended to lure Imperial forces. In case of a future attack, the Rebels planed to reveal on purpose other Rebel facilities connected to the abandoned outpost to draw the Imperials away from the Polis Massa Research Base and major Rebel outposts.<ref name="Strongholds" />
